current_evidence: Croydon's 'Submit your planning application' page links 'Our Local Validation checklist (PDF 550KB)' to this exact file and says it 'was updated in May 2026 following public consultation'. The document says it was published in May 2026 after consultation from 9 March to 20 April 2026.

issues.detail: List date 2026-04-01 comes from the upload folder in the URL. The document and the linking page give May 2026 as the publication/update date, and the list applies for 2 years from the date on the cover.
issues.evidence: Planning page: 'updated in May 2026 following public consultation'

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none)', but Croydon's 'All applications' and constraint-based items apply to householder applications: Biodiversity Statement (BNG exemption); Fire Statement or Reasonable Exception Statement; Flood Risk Assessment (for householder extensions a brief flood risk statement, flood map search and proportionate measures); Photos; Pre-Application Advice / Community Engagement Statement; Tree Survey (BS5837) where trees are on or next to the site; Heritage Statement where a heritage asset is affected; Design and Access Statement for 100sqm+ extensions. Croydon has no separate householder table, so these general items are what applies.
issues.evidence: Source: 'Householder extensions may need a brief flood risk statement, a flood map search, and proportionate measures such as a water butt or permeable paving'

issues.detail: Local requirements with clear triggers that Grokbot did not capture: Design and Access Statement (100sqm+, 1+ home in a designated area, LBC, Large Minors+); Refuse and Recycling Strategy (Minors+); Construction Management/Logistics Plan scoping note (Large Minors+); BREEAM Pre-assessment (large non-residential Minors+); Agent of Change Assessment, Public Art Strategy, Air Quality Assessment, Draft Delivery and Servicing Plan, Draft Travel Plan, Health Impact Assessment, Noise and Vibration Impact Assessment, Safety Security and Resilience to Emergency Strategy, and Urban Greening Factor assessment (all Majors); Circular Economy Statement and Whole Life-Cycle Carbon Assessment (GLA-referable Majors); Housing Quality Statement (all residential); original and proposed floorspace calculation (extensions in Green Belt/MOL); Community Facilities Statement; Assessment of Need and Management Plan (supported/specialist housing); Preliminary Roost Assessment (demolition, conversion of a vacant building, buildings or trees with roost potential); Healthy Catering Commitment (hot food takeaways); Energy Design Statement (residential Minors); Aviation Impact Assessment, TVIA and TV/Radio Reception assessment (tall buildings); Application Inventory; topographical, demolition and engineering drawings.
issues.evidence: Croydon Local Validation List May 2026, 'Development Size', 'Development Type' and 'Site Constraints' tables

issues.detail: Outline is marked '(none)', but the list requires a Design Code for GLA-referable outline Majors.
issues.evidence: Development Size table: 'Design Code - GLA referable outline Majors'

issues.detail: The Environmental Statement (EIA) trigger is Preliminary Roost Assessment text ('A Preliminary Roost Assessment (PRA) is required where a vacant building is converted...'). The Ventilation/Extraction trigger is a copy of the Affordable Housing Statement text ('The affordable housing statement must include: a schedule...'). Neither describes when its requirement applies. Correct triggers: EIA development; non-residential Minors with plant, ventilation, extraction or air conditioning.
issues.evidence: Source: 'Environmental Statement - EIA development'; 'Ventilation/Extraction Statement - Non-residential Minors involving plant, ventilation, extraction or air conditioning'

issues.detail: Several triggers are fragments taken from other entries. Drainage Strategy: 'measures and sustainable drainage where necessary. 4.' (FRA text; the source trigger is Large Minors+). Planning Statement: '...1:50 drawings ... cycle storage, bin storage' (source: Minors+). Existing and proposed site levels: landscaping and 'CHAPTER 3: DEFINITIONS' text (source: topographical drawings for new buildings, significant level changes and/or basements). Statement of Community Involvement: 'the Council's Statement of Community Involvement.' (source: Community Engagement Statement for Large Minors+). Open space: 'communal and play space).' (source: Open Space and Recreation Assessment where open space, sports/recreation land or playing fields are affected). Parking: 'complies with parking standards.' Cycle parking and Waste: bin/cycle store drawing fragment.
issues.evidence: Croydon Local Validation List May 2026 tables

issues.detail: Several triggers leave out the actual thresholds. Daylight/Sunlight: no 'Majors'. Contaminated Land: quotes only the exemption ('will not be required if there is no evidence...') rather than 'Majors; sites with previous polluting uses'. Archaeological Assessment: no 'Majors within an Archaeological Priority Area; Majors over 0.5ha'. Energy: quotes carbon-offset content rather than 'Energy Assessment - Majors' / 'Energy Design Statement - residential Minors'. Viability: 'a Financial Viability Assessment (FVA) must be submitted.' with no trigger (Major residential not meeting fast-track criteria). Retail: only the 2,500sqm RIA threshold, not the sequential test/impact assessment for town centre uses in edge-of-centre or out-of-centre locations. Transport: described as majors only, but a Transport Statement is required for Minors+ and a full TA for Majors.
issues.evidence: Source: 'Archaeological Assessment - Majors within an Archaeological Priority Area; Majors over 0.5Ha'; 'Transport Assessment/Statement - Minors+ (full Transport Assessment for Majors)'

issues.detail: The Affordable Housing Statement trigger merges in the next table row ('Ventilation / Extraction Statement* Major Residential Nonresidential Minors'). The 'Pre-application advice' trigger is the Council's service description ('The Council complies with the Government's duty to offer a positive and proactive approach'), not a requirement trigger.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger excerpts for Affordable Housing Statement and Pre-application advice

issues.detail: Nearly every requirement is 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', but the source keys requirements to size bands (All applications / Minors+ / Large Minors+ / Majors / GLA referable) and development types. Items marked 'All applications' (Fire Statement, Photos, BNG statement, CIL form, Plans/Block plan) also apply to householder, LBC and other types. Items that are Majors-only (Daylight/Sunlight, Contaminated Land, Archaeology, Affordable Housing Statement, Wind for tall buildings) are presented as if they applied to all full applications.
issues.evidence: Source: 'Development Size: Check this table to see if there are additional requirements due to the size of your development'

issues.detail: 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space' is not a separate requirement in the list. It is taken from the Housing Quality Statement text (amenity space provision). 'Marketing / vacancy evidence' and 'Employment / Economic Statement' both quote the same Employment Assessment entry, so they duplicate one requirement.
issues.evidence: Grokbot triggers: 'size, and amenity space provision (including private, communal and play space)'; 'Loss of employment land or floorspace Applications must demonstrate...' repeated

issues.detail: Several tab_items are boilerplate or fragments, not requirements: 'Pre-application advice is confidential as it can be commercially sensitive...'; 'If the additional information is not received, the application will be returned to you...' (process); 'Typical duration of placements and eligibility criteria for residents Any confidential information must be provided as a separate appendix' (fragment of the employment and skills text); 'No personal data from consultation respondents is included in this Consultation Statement.' (taken from the consultation statement appended to the list, not a requirement).

The drawing-standard items are garbled. One ends with a stray list number ('...show at least 2 streets for easy identification. 2.'). 'Street elevations are required for new buildings ... heights annotated20 Section Drawings For extensions...' runs the Elevations and Section Drawings entries together with a footnote number.

summary: Grokbot's link is Croydon's current May 2026 local validation list. The date is off by a month because it came from the URL path. The extraction misses about 30 local requirements (including the whole Majors and Development Type tables), marks Householder '(none)', and has several triggers copied from the wrong entries (EIA, Ventilation, Planning Statement, Drainage).
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
